item.title: The importance of public engagement in maintaining trust in banknotes - Speech by Victoria Cleland

rating.summary: Victoria Cleland, Executive Director for Payments at the Bank of England, delivered a speech at the Intergraf Currency & Identity Conference focusing on maintaining public trust in banknotes through availability, secure design, and public engagement. The speech covers the Bank's cash ecosystem oversight, counterfeit resilience efforts, and a public consultation that selected UK wildlife imagery for the next banknote series. No monetary policy stance or interest rate commentary is presented.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is entirely about banknote design, cash distribution infrastructure, and public communications strategy, with no discussion of interest rates, inflation, or monetary policy decisions.
key_quotes: Every time someone accepts a banknote, they trust that it is authentic and worth the value stated.
Trust in banknotes begins with secure design but only endures if banknotes are available and recognised.
